title: fix: fall back when a provider rejects our region
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: A provider 400 response saying `User location is not supported` now sends the request to the model’s next declared fallback target; other 400 responses still return to the caller. The fix applies to every model with a fallback, not just TTS. It addresses the failure path that stopped 208 `google/gemini-3.8-flash-tts` calls on 2026-10-03 from reaching their OpenRouter (AI Studio) fallback.
